prompt: A clear straight-on top-down tactical whiteboard of a volleyball court's six-player rotation, drawn as a 2-row by 3-column grid of position zones with a jersey number written in each zone. The FRONT row (nearest the net), left to right, is zones 4, 3, 2; the BACK row, left to right, is zones 5, 6, 1. The starting line-up is: zone 1 = number 7, zone 2 = number 3, zone 3 = number 11, zone 4 = number 6, zone 5 = number 9, zone 6 = number 4. The team wins the serve back three times; on each side-out every player rotates one zone clockwise (the player in zone 2 moves to zone 1, zone 3 to zone 2, and so on, zone 1 wrapping to zone 6). Draw the court AFTER three rotations, writing each player's jersey number in the zone they now occupy. No arrows, no names, no extra text.
easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show top-down volleyball tactical whiteboard, a 2x3 grid of court zones with a jersey number in each zone? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

steps.read_grid: the 2-row by 3-column grid of jersey numbers actually written on the court (transcribe exactly what is drawn; do not rotate or simulate anything)

steps.target: one position zone of the court grid with a jersey number written inside it

steps.read_crop: Does this picture show ONE whole grid cell of a court diagram with a jersey number written inside it, rather than bare board or only part of a cell? Answer yes or no only.

steps.read_number: Read the jersey number written in zone 1 (back row, rightmost zone) after the rotations. Report just the number. Read ONLY the digit(s) actually printed on the image for that line; do NOT do any sums, redo it or correct it -- report exactly what is printed even if it looks wrong. Answer with digits only.

steps.target: an arrow, a player name, or any other writing on the whiteboard that is not a jersey number

steps.read_number: This volleyball tactical grid is drawn as rows and columns of zones. How many ROWS of zones are there? Answer with a whole number only.
